590: /**
591:  * @brief     Set the filter configuration
592:  *
593:  * The filter is used to configure what kind of management packets can be received
594:  * by the filter callback registered by bk_wifi_filter_register_cb().
595:  *
596:  * Per the WiFi receiving data path, the management frames are firstly received by
597:  * WiFi hardware, then the hardware relays them to WiFi software (WiFi driver). Normally
598:  * the hardware receives all management frames in the air, however it don't
599:  * relay all of them to WiFi driver (WiFi software), it only relays management frames
600:  * necessary to STA or AP or scan or monitor, depends on which interface or function are
601:  * enabled. In other word, WiFi driver only receives management frames necessary to them
602:  * from hardware.
603:  *
604:  * When no filter callback is registered, all management frame processing is ended
605:  * in WiFi driver unless the filter callback is registered.
606:  *
607:  * If filter callback is register and if filter_config.rx_all_default_mgmt is set to 1,
608:  * then all the management frames received by WiFi driver are relayed to the filter
609:  * callback. **Notified that the default management frame types can be received depends
610:  * on whether STA or AP or scan or monitor are enabled or not, e.g. when only STA is
611:  * enabled, the WiFi driver needs to handle PROBE response, but don't need to handle PROBE
612:  * request, so the WiFi driver only receive PROBE response from WiFi hardware**.
613:  *
614:  * Here is summary about default management frame received by WiFi:
615:  *  Condition      | Default management frame
616:  * ----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------
617:  *  STA connected  | Management frames sent by the connected AP, such as beacon etc.
618:  *  AP started     | Management frames sent by connected STA and probe request etc.
619:  *  Scan starting  | Probe response and beacon frames of all APs.
620:  *  Monitor started| All kind of management frames
621:  *
622:  * How about if the filter callback wants to receive more management frame types,
623:  * e.g. want to receive PROBE request when only STA is enabled. We can set
624:  * filter_config->rx_probe_req to receive PROBE response no matter whether AP is enabled
625:  * or NOT.
626:  *
627:  * Usage example:
628:  *
629:  *     // Only receive management frame default received by WiFi driver
630:  *     // Equal to the case when bk_wifi_filter_set_config() is not called
631:  *     wifi_filter_config_t filter_config = WIFI_DEFAULT_FILTER_CONFIG();
632:  *     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_wifi_filter_set_config(&filter_config);
633:  *
634:  *     // Receive all beacon and management frames default received by WiFi driver
635:  *     filter_config.rx_all_beacon = 1;
636:  *     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_wifi_filter_set_config(&filter_config);
637:  *
638:  *     // Only receive all beacon
639:  *     filter_config.rx_all_beacon = 1;
640:  *     filter_config.rx_all_default_mgmt = 0;
641:  *     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_wifi_filter_set_config(&filter_config);
642:  *
643:  * @attention 1. If this API is not called, the default filter is to relay all
644:  *               mamangement frames received by WiFi driver to the filter callback.
645:  * @attention 2. If STA is enabled, the WiFi driver only receives beacon from the
646:  *               connected AP, if scan is enabled or filter_config->rx_all_beacon
647:  *               is set, the WiFi driver receives beacons of all APs.
648:  *
649:  * @param filter_config configuration of filter
650:  *

3664: int bk_wifi_p2p_coexist_force_op_channel(struct p2p_data *p2p,

3666: {

3670: 
3671: 	if (!p2p || !intersection)
3672: 		return 0;
3673: 
3674: 	ch = bk_wifi_p2p_get_coexist_anchor_channel();
3675: 	if (!ch)

3683: 		return 0;
3684: 
3685: 	if (!p2p_channels_includes(intersection, op_reg_class, op_channel))
3686: 		return 0;

3688: 	p2p->op_reg_class = op_reg_class;
3689: 	p2p->op_channel = op_channel;
3690: 	p2p->own_freq_preference = freq;
3691: 	WIFI_LOGD("P2P coexist: force GO op channel %u (freq %u MHz)\n",
3692: 		  op_channel, freq);
3693: 	return 1;

46: /*
47:  * Coexistence netif wire id (2-bit co_hdr.vif_idx). Roles are NOT pinned to a
48:  * fixed LMAC VIF index any more (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1 so the MCC
49:  * channel scheduler can handle them). We therefore key the wire id off the
50:  * (netif type, p2p) role instead of the LMAC index:
51:  *
52:  *   wire 0 = infra STA   (STA-type, !p2p) -> host g_mlan
53:  *   wire 1 = SoftAP      (AP-type,  !p2p) -> host g_uap
54:  *   wire 2 = P2P GO      (AP-type,   p2p) -> host g_p2p_go
55:  *   wire 3 = P2P GC      (STA-type,  p2p) -> host g_p2p_gc
56:  *
57:  * The TX path is symmetric: host tags the wire id, CP maps it back to the
58:  * current LMAC VIF index via cif_wire_to_lmac_vif() (no longer identity).
59:  */
60: static uint8_t cif_vif_to_netif_wire(void *vif)
61: {
62:     netif_if_t t = wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif);
63:     bool p2p = cif_vif_is_p2p(vif);
64: 
65:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_AP) && p2p)
66:         return 2;
67:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_STA) && p2p)
68:         return 3;
69: 
70:     return (uint8_t)t;
71: }
72: 
73: /*
74:  * Reverse of cif_vif_to_netif_wire(): map a host wire id back to the LMAC VIF
75:  * index currently held by that role. Since GO/GC float on vif0/vif1, the old
76:  * identity mapping (wire==index) no longer holds, so look the role up in the
77:  * active VIF table. Falls back to the wire id if no active match is found.
78:  */
79: static uint8_t cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(uint8_t wire)
80: {
81:     netif_if_t want_type;
82:     bool want_p2p;
83: 
84:     switch (wire)
85:     {
86:         case 0: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = false; break;
87:         case 1: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = false; break;
88:         case 2: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = true;  break;
89:         case 3: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = true;  break;
90:         default: return wire;
91:     }
92: 
93:     for (void *vif = mac_vif_mgmt_first_vif(); vif != NULL;
94:          vif = mac_vif_mgmt_next_vif(vif))
95:     {
96:         if ((wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif) == want_type) &&
97:             (cif_vif_is_p2p(vif) == want_p2p))
98:             return wifi_netif_vif_to_vifid(vif);
99:     }
100: 
101:     return wire;
102: }

107:     uint8_t sap_vif_id = vif_mgmt_get_softap_vif_index();

118:         {
119:             return sta_vif_id + 0xF;

121:         else

123:             return sap_vif_id + 0xF;

133:     }
134: 
135:     return INVALID_VIF_IDX;

320:     }

325:     g_wifi.waiting_id = command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET;
326:     g_wifi.waiting_sequence = sequence;
327:     g_wifi.command_result = -ETIMEDOUT;
328:     g_wifi.command_length = 0;
329:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
330:   }
331:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_TX_CHANNEL, 0,
332:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
333:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
334:                        wifi_command_transport_complete, slot);
335:   if (ret < 0)
336:     {
337:       *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
338:       slot->owned = false;
339:       slot->transport_pending = false;
340:       {
341:         irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
342: 
343:         if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
344:             g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
345:           {
346:             g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
347:           }
348:         rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
349:       }
350:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
351:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
352:       return ret;
353:     }
354:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
355: 
356:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.command_sem,
357:                                        WIFI_COMMAND_TIMEOUT);
358:   {
359:     irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
360: 
361:     if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
362:         g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
363:       {
364:         g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
365:       }
366:     if (ret >= 0)
367:       {
368:         ret = g_wifi.command_result;
369:       }
370:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
371:   }
372: 
373:   if (ret >= 0 && result != NULL && result_size != 0)
374:     {
375:       uint16_t copy = g_wifi.command_length < result_size ?
376:                       g_wifi.command_length : result_size;
377:       memcpy(result, g_wifi.command_data, copy);
378:     }
379:   if (ret >= 0 && result_length != NULL)
380:     {
381:       *result_length = g_wifi.command_length;
382:     }
383: 
384:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
385:   wifi_command_reap();
386:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
387:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
388:   return ret;
389: }

440: static bool wifi_sync_reset_generation(void)
441: {
442:   struct wifi_pending_node nodes[WIFI_NODE_QUEUE];
443:   uint32_t generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
444:   bool wake_command = false;
445:   unsigned int kept = 0;
446:   unsigned int i;
447:   irqstate_t flags;
448: 
449:   if (generation == g_wifi.reset_generation)
450:     {
451:       return false;
452:     }
453: 
454:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
455:   if (g_wifi.waiting_id != 0)
456:     {
457:       g_wifi.command_result = -ECONNRESET;
458:       g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
459:       wake_command = true;
460:     }
461: 
462:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
463:   if (wake_command)
464:     {
465:       nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
466:     }
467: 
468:   wifi_set_carrier(false);
469:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
470:   wifi_scan_cache_clear();
471:   g_wifi.scan_running = false;
472:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
473: 
474:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
475:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
476:   generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
477: 
478:   /* A peer generation change proves the old CP can no longer reference AP
479:    * command slots.  TX slots remain quarantined because DMA completion is
480:    * not proven by a CP reset.
481:    */
482: 
483:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
484:     {
485:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
486:           g_wifi.command[i].generation != generation)
487:         {
488:           *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes =
489:             BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
490:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
491:           g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending = false;
492:         }
493:     }
494:   g_wifi.reset_generation = generation;
495:   for (i = 0; i < g_wifi.node_count; i++)
496:     {
497:       unsigned int index = (g_wifi.node_head + i) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
498: 
499:       if (g_wifi.nodes[index].generation == generation)
500:         {
501:           nodes[kept++] = g_wifi.nodes[index];
502:         }
503:     }
504:   memcpy(g_wifi.nodes, nodes, kept * sizeof(nodes[0]));
505:   g_wifi.node_head = 0;
506:   g_wifi.node_tail = kept % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
507:   g_wifi.node_count = kept;
508:   g_wifi.packet_head = 0;
509:   g_wifi.packet_tail = 0;
510:   g_wifi.packet_count = 0;
511:   for (i = 0; i < WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE; i++)
512:     {
513:       if (g_wifi.recycle[i].state != WIFI_RECYCLE_FREE &&
514:           g_wifi.recycle[i].generation != generation)
515:         {
516:           g_wifi.recycle[i].state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
517:         }
518:     }
519:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
520:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
521:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
522:   return true;
523: }

529:       return -E2BIG;

531:

537: static int wifi_scan_cache_event(uint16_t command, const void *data,
538:                                  size_t length)
539: {
540:   struct iw_event event;
541: 
542:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
543:   event.cmd = command;
544:   event.len = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + length;
545:   if (length > sizeof(event.u))
546:     {
547:       return -E2BIG;
548:     }
549:   memcpy(&event.u, data, length);
550:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
551: }

553: static int wifi_scan_cache_build_record(
554:   const struct bk7258_wifi_scan_record *record)
555: {
556:   struct iw_event event;
557:   struct iw_quality quality;
558:   struct iw_freq frequency;
559:   uint16_t flags;
560:   size_t ssid_length;
561:   size_t padded_length;
562:   size_t event_length;
563:   int ret;
564: 
565:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
566:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWAP;
567:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(ap_addr);
568:   event.u.ap_addr.sa_family = ARPHRD_ETHER;
569:   memcpy(event.u.ap_addr.sa_data, record->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
570:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
571:   if (ret < 0)
572:     {
573:       return ret;
574:     }
575: 
576:   ssid_length = strnlen(record->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
577:   padded_length = (ssid_length + 3u) & ~3u;
578:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
579:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWESSID;
580:   event.u.essid.flags = IW_ESSID_ON;
581:   event.u.essid.length = ssid_length;
582:   event.u.essid.pointer = (void *)(uintptr_t)sizeof(struct iw_point);
583:   event_length = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + sizeof(struct iw_point) +
584:                  padded_length;
585:   event.len = event_length;
586:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, offsetof(struct iw_event, u) +
587:                                sizeof(struct iw_point));
588:   if (ret < 0)
589:     {
590:       return ret;
591:     }
592:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(record->ssid, ssid_length);
593:   if (ret < 0)
594:     {
595:       return ret;
596:     }
597:   if (padded_length != ssid_length)
598:     {
599:       uint32_t padding = 0;
600:       ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&padding, padded_length - ssid_length);
601:       if (ret < 0)
602:         {
603:           return ret;
604:         }
605:     }
606: 
607:   memset(&quality, 0, sizeof(quality));
608:   quality.level = (uint8_t)record->rssi;
609:   quality.updated = IW_QUAL_DBM;
610:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(IWEVQUAL, &quality, sizeof(quality));
611:   if (ret < 0)
612:     {
613:       return ret;
614:     }
615: 
616:   memset(&frequency, 0, sizeof(frequency));
617:   frequency.m = record->channel;
618:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(SIOCGIWFREQ, &frequency, sizeof(frequency));
619:   if (ret < 0)
620:     {
621:       return ret;
622:     }
623: 
624:   flags = record->security == 0 ? IW_ENCODE_DISABLED : IW_ENCODE_ENABLED;
625:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
626:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWENCODE;
627:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(data);
628:   event.u.data.flags = flags;
629:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
630: }

632: static int wifi_scan_cache_fetch(void)
633: {
634:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_request request;
635:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_response response;
636:   uint16_t start = 0;
637:   uint16_t total = 0;
638:   uint16_t result_length;
639:   int ret;
640: 
641:   g_wifi.scan_cache = kmm_malloc(WIFI_SCAN_CACHE_LIMIT);
642:   if (g_wifi.scan_cache == NULL)
643:     {
644:       return -ENOMEM;
645:     }
646: 
647:   do
648:     {
649:       memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
650:       request.start = start;
651:       request.max_records = BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS;
652:       memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
653:       ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE,
654:                          &request, sizeof(request), &response,
655:                          sizeof(response), &result_length);
656:       if (ret < 0)
657:         {
658:           printf("wifi scan page transport failed: %d\n", ret);
659:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
660:           return ret;
661:         }
662:       if (result_length != sizeof(response) || response.status != 0 ||
663:           response.page.start != start ||
664:           response.page.count > BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS ||
665:           response.page.reserved != 0 ||
666:           response.page.total < start ||
667:           response.page.count > response.page.total - start)
668:         {
669:           printf("wifi scan page invalid: status=%ld start=%u count=%u "
670:                  "total=%u length=%u\n",
671:                  (long)response.status, response.page.start,
672:                  response.page.count, response.page.total, result_length);
673:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
674:           return response.status != 0 ? response.status : -EPROTO;
675:         }
676: 
677:       if (start == 0)
678:         {
679:           total = response.page.total;
680:         }
681:       else if (response.page.total != total)
682:         {
683:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
684:           return -EPROTO;
685:         }
686: 
687:       for (uint8_t i = 0; i < response.page.count; i++)
688:         {
689:           ret = wifi_scan_cache_build_record(&response.page.records[i]);
690:           if (ret < 0)
691:             {
692:               wifi_scan_cache_clear();
693:               return ret;
694:             }
695:         }
696: 
697:       start += response.page.count;
698:       if (response.page.more != (start < total) ||
699:           (response.page.count == 0 && start < total))
700:         {
701:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
702:           return -EPROTO;
703:         }
704:     }
705:   while (start < total);
706: 
707:   g_wifi.scan_cached = true;
708:   return OK;
709: }

712: {

716:     {
717:       *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)pattern_address =
718:         BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
719:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");

723: static void wifi_handle_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
724:                                 uint32_t generation)
725: {
726:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
727:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
728:   uint8_t data[sizeof(g_wifi.command_data)];
729:   uint32_t event_address;
730:   uint16_t length;
731:   uint16_t copied;
732:   irqstate_t flags;
733: 
734:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
735:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
736:       !wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
737:     {
738:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
739:       return;
740:     }
741: 
742:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
743:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
744:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
745:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
746:     {
747:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
748:       return;
749:     }
750: 
751:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
752:   length = event.length;
753:   if (length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
754:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, length))
755:     {
756:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
757:       return;
758:     }
759: 
760:   copied = length < sizeof(data) ? length : sizeof(data);
761:   if (copied != 0)
762:     {
763:       memcpy(data, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
764:                                               WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
765:              copied);
766:     }
767:   wifi_release_cp_command(cpdu_address);
768:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
769: 
770:   if (event.id >= BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET)
771:     {
772:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
773: 
774:       if (event.id == g_wifi.waiting_id &&
775:           event.sequence == g_wifi.waiting_sequence)
776:         {
777:           if (copied != 0)
778:             {
779:               memcpy(g_wifi.command_data, data, copied);
780:             }
781:           g_wifi.command_length = copied;
782:           g_wifi.command_result = OK;
783:           g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
784:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
785:           nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
786:         }
787:       else
788:         {
789:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
790:         }
791:     }
792:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_IPV4_IND)
793:     {
794:       wifi_set_carrier(true);
795:     }
796:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND && copied >= 4)
797:     {
798:       uint16_t event_id;
799: 
800:       memcpy(&event_id, data, sizeof(event_id));
801:       if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_CONNECTED)
802:         {
803:           wifi_set_carrier(true);
804:         }
805:       else if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_DISCONNECTED)
806:         {
807:           wifi_set_carrier(false);
808:         }
809:     }
810:   else if (event.id == 3u)
811:     {
812:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
813:     }
814:   else if (event.id == 8u)
815:     {
816:       g_wifi.scan_running = false;
817:     }
818: 
819: }

821: static bool wifi_validate_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
822:                                   uint32_t *next, uint32_t generation)
823: {
824:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
825:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
826:   uint32_t event_address;
827:   irqstate_t flags;
828: 
829:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
830:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
831:       !wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
832:     {
833:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
834:       return false;
835:     }
836: 
837:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
838:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
839:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
840:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
841:     {
842:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
843:       return false;
844:     }
845: 
846:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
847:   if (event.length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
848:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, event.length))
849:     {
850:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
851:       return false;
852:     }
853: 
854:   *next = cpdu.next;
855:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
856:   return true;
857: }

859: static void wifi_handle_command_list(const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
860:                                      uint32_t generation)
861: {
862:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
863:   uint32_t address = node->head;
864:   unsigned int count;
865: 
866:   if (node->channel != 0 || node->num == 0 ||
867:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
868:     {
869:       return;
870:     }
871: 
872:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
873:     {
874:       uint32_t next;
875:       unsigned int previous;
876: 
877:       if (!wifi_validate_command(address, &next, generation))
878:         {
879:           return;
880:         }
881:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
882:         {
883:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
884:             {
885:               return;
886:             }
887:         }
888:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
889:         {
890:           return;
891:         }
892: 
893:       addresses[count] = address;
894:       address = next;
895:     }
896: 
897:   if (address != 0)
898:     {
899:       return;
900:     }
901: 
902:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
903:     {
904:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
905:         {
906:           return;
907:         }
908: 
909:       wifi_handle_command(addresses[count], generation);
910:     }
911: }

931: static void wifi_tx_transport_complete(
932:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
933: {
934:   struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = arg;
935:   bool wake = false;
936:   irqstate_t flags;
937: 
938:   (void)ack;

1: Wi-Fi AP/STA/P2P Mode Example
2: =============================================
3: 
4: This chapter shows three modes of BEKEN Wi-Fi module: STA、SoftAP、P2P.
5: 
6: - Wi-Fi Enables STA mode
7: - Wi-Fi Enables SoftAP mode
8: - Wi-Fi Enables P2P Mode (under development)
9: 
10: Example and Configuration
11: --------------------------------------------------
12: STA and SoftAP modes are supported by default. The function of P2P need to enable macro ``CONFIG_COMPONENTS_P2P`` in file ``middleware/soc/bk72xx.defconfig`` .
13: 
14: .. Note:: Please contact BEKEN support team for further details about P2P function
15: 
16: Source Code Process
17: --------------------------------------------------
18: Wi-Fi STA Mode
19: +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
20: V1
21: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
22: 
23: The BEKEN Wi-Fi module runs a command to enter the corresponding mode. After entering ``net mode``, user can view the supported mode.
24: ::
25: 
26:      net mode <mode>
27:           - net mode sta
28:           - net mode ap
29: 
30: The entry of STA mode is ``cmd_wlan_sta_exec`` which is located in ``properties/modules/bk_wifi_impl/wifi_wpa_cmd.c``. This function configures/obtains the corresponding configuration through set/get command respectively. The common ones are as follows:
31: ::
32: 
33:      net sta config <ssid> [psk]
34:           - net sta config ssid_example
35:           - net sta config ssid_example psk_example
36: 
37:      net sta set <field> <value>
38:           - net sta set ssid ssid_example
39:           - net sta set psk psk_example
40:           - net sta set scan_ssid (0, 1)
41:      net sta enable
42:      net sta disable
43: 
44:      cmd example:
45:      net sta enable
46:      net sta config BEKEN_TEST 12345678
47:      net sta connect
48: 
49: V2
50: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
51: 
52: On the basis of V1, BEKEN has completed the adaptation of second version of commands by customizing customer requirements. Comparing with original one, this version simplifies use of commands, a single command to achieve STA mode connection. The file locates at ``components/bk_cli/cli_wifi.c`` and it needs to enable macro ``CLI_CFG_WIFI=1``. The usage of STA mode is as follows:
53: ::
54: 
55:      {"scan", "scan [ssid]", cli_wifi_scan_cmd}
56:      {"sta", "sta ssid [password][bssid][channel]", cli_wifi_sta_cmd}
57:      {"state", "state - show STA/AP state", cli_wifi_state_cmd}
58:      {"stop", "stop {sta|ap}", cli_wifi_stop_cmd}
59: 
60:      cmd example:
61:      sta BEKEN_TEST 12345678
62: 
63: .. note:: V2 version is compatible with V1 version
64: 
65: Wi-Fi SoftAP Mode
66: ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
67: The entry of SoftAP mode is ``cmd_wlan_ap_exec`` in V1 version and source code is same as STA mode. The main configuration parameters are SSID and password.
68: ::
69: 
70:      net ap set <field> <value>
71:           - net ap set ssid ssid_example
72:           - net ap set psk psk_example
73:      net ap enable
74:      net ap reload
75:      net ap disable
76: 
77:      cmd example:
78:      net ap enable
79:      net ap set ssid BEKEN_TEST
80:      net ap set psk 12345678
81:      net ap start
82: 
83: Entry of V2 version is ``cli_wifi_ap_cmd`` which is located in ``components/bk_cli/cli_wifi.c``, the detailed introduction is as follows:
84: ::
85: 
86:      {"ap", "ap ssid [password]", cli_wifi_ap_cmd}
87:      {"stop", "stop {sta|ap}", cli_wifi_stop_cmd}
88:      {"state", "state - show STA/AP state", cli_wifi_state_cmd}
89: 
90:      cmd example:
91:      ap BEKEN_TEST 12345678
92: 
93: .. Note:: BEKEN Wi-Fi module supports AP+STA coexist
94: 
95: Wi-Fi P2P Mode
96: +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
97: P2P Mode is still under development. The entry function ``cmd_wlan_p2p_exec`` can be used to configure the SSID of P2P and default name is ``beken p2p`` . The role of P2P is decided by negotiating, but could be assigned by the value of ``param.intent`` . The command to enable P2P function is as follows:
98: ::
99: 
100:      net p2p enable
101: 
102: .. Note:: Please contact BEKEN support team for further details about P2P function
103: 
104:

text:
**总判定**

- `bk_idk` 原生支持 SoftAP 和 AP+STA 共存；API、hostapd、独立 AP netif、DHCP server 和 AP/STA VIF 数据路径均存在。
- `bk_avdk_smp` 也支持 SoftAP/AP+STA，但射频、hostapd 和真实 VIF 在 CP，AP CPU 上的同名 API 主要是 IPC 代理，本地负责 lwIP/netif。
- contest 当前只交付了一个 STA 型 NuttX `netdev_lowerhalf`。CP 固件保留启动/停止 AP 的旧协议命令，但 NuttX 前端没有暴露这些命令、没有第二 AP netdev，也没有按 RX 接口分流，因此当前 contest 不能视为已支持 SoftAP 或 AP+STA。
- 全程只读，没有修改文件。

**AP API**

公开声明位于 [wifi.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/include/modules/wifi.h:338)，五个目标 API 均存在。

- `bk_wifi_ap_start()`：实现会先检查 `WIFI_AP_CONFIGURED_BIT`，未配置直接返回 `BK_ERR_WIFI_AP_NOT_CONFIG`，见 [wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3067)。这与头文件“未调用 set_config 时使用默认值”的说明不一致。
- start 初始化 AP driver、启用/重载 hostapd/VIF，并在启用 lwIP 时调用 `uap_ip_start()`，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3081)。
- `bk_wifi_ap_stop()` 幂等；会广播 deauth、关闭 AP 硬件和 VIF，并在 STA 仍存在时恢复 STA role，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3257)。这一版 `bk_idk` stop 路径没有显式 `uap_ip_down()`；SMP CP 版则明确调用，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:4002)。是否由其他关闭路径代劳需实板检查。
- `bk_wifi_ap_set_config()` 在 AP 已启动时自动 stop/start，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3214)。
- `bk_wifi_ap_get_config()` 只回填 `ssid/password/channel/security`，不清零结构，也不返回 `hidden/acs/vsie/max_con/reserved`，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3243)。调用者若不先清零，会得到部分旧值。
- `bk_wifi_ap_get_mac()` 检查空指针后使用 `bk_get_mac(..., MAC_TYPE_AP)`，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3699)。AP MAC 是由系统 base MAC 派生，不是 STA MAC 的别名。

SMP AP 侧对应 API 是 IPC 代理：

- AP MAC 经 `AP_GET_MAC` 从 CP 获取，[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:344)。
- start/set/stop 分别发送 `AP_START/AP_SET_CONFIG/AP_STOP`，[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:711)。
- CP 端命令最终调用真实的 `bk_wifi_ap_*`，[cif_wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_api.c:498)。
- AP-side `get_config()` 只读本地缓存，不从 CP 回读，同样只返回四个字段，[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:1060)。运行中发生 CSA/ACS 后可能不是射频真实值。
- 已证实的错误路径问题：`AP_SET_CONFIG` IPC 失败时在释放 `buffer_to_ipc` 前直接返回，[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:927)；`AP_STOP` IPC 失败只记录日志，仍清本地状态并返回 `BK_OK`，[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:953)。

**配置字段与校验**

`bk_idk` 的结构定义在 [wifi_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/include/modules/wifi_types.h:529)：`ssid`、`password`、`channel`、`security`、`hidden`、`acs`、`vsie_len/vsie`、`max_con`、`max_statype_num[4]`、`reserved[32]`。SMP 增加 `disable_dns_server` bit，[wifi_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/wifi_types.h:541)。

已证实的校验行为：

- 默认配置是 SSID `ap_default_ssid`、空密码、channel 0、WPA2 mixed、非隐藏、`max_con=0`，[wifi_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/include/modules/wifi_types.h:91)。由于密码长度小于 8 会强制转成 open，默认声明的 WPA2 实际不会生效。
- 外层 validator 基本只检查 NULL 和部分 5 GHz 非 DFS channel，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3790)。
- 实际 channel 接受 1–14 或 0；BK7258 不进入源码中的 5 GHz SOC 条件。contest CP 旧 AP handler 也明确拒绝 `band==1`，[cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:362)。
- SSID 通过 `strlen` 取长度后截断到 32；空 SSID未拒绝。密码同样依赖 NUL 终止，未见长度上限校验，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3861)。传入未终止数组可能越界读取。
- 密码长度 `<8` 时无条件使用 open；`>=8` 时 SMP 根据 `security` 选择 WPA/WPA2/WPA3，未知值回退 WPA2-AES，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3865)。
- `max_con==0` 或超过驱动上限时回退默认最大值，不返回错误，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3846)。
- `hidden`、条件编译下的 VSIE 和 station-type limit 会应用；`acs` 未见消费。`reserved` 文档要求全零，且定义了 `BK_ERR_WIFI_RESERVED_FIELD`，但此路径未实际检查。
- SMP 直接通过 IPC 传递完整 `sizeof(wifi_ap_config_t)`，[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:888)。AP/CP 的 bitfield、packing、配置宏必须完全一致；当前两侧源码结构一致，但这是 ABI 耦合点。

**AP+STA 与事件**

- 官方文档明确写明支持 AP+STA coexist，[bk_wifi_mode.rst](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/docs/bk7236n/en/developer-guide/wifi/bk_wifi_mode.rst:93)。
- 驱动发现另一角色已存在时把 role 切成 `CONFIG_ROLE_COEXIST`，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:298)。
- STA 关联后会通过 CSA 将 AP 调整到 STA 频点，[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:288)。因此应按单射频同信道共存理解，不是独立双信道 AP+STA。
- 公开 Wi-Fi 事件包括 STA connected/disconnected 和 AP client connected/disconnected，但没有 AP start/stop 公共事件，[wifi_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/include/modules/wifi_types.h:153)。
- STA connected 载荷是 SSID+BSSID，disconnect 带 reason/local_generated；AP connect/disconnect 载荷只有客户端 MAC，[wifi_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/include/modules/wifi_types.h:671)。
- CP hostapd 在客户端关联/离开时发送旧 IPC indication，并发布 `EVENT_WIFI_AP_CONNECTED/DISCONNECTED`，[notify.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/wpa_supplicant-2.10/wpa_supplicant/notify.c:641)。AP CPU 再发布本地事件，[wdrv_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_cntrl.c:226)。
- CP/AP 的 public event enum 对 STA_CONNECTED 数值并不完全相同：CP 前面有两个 CSI event，AP 前面是 ASSOCIATED；AP connect/disconnect 仍对齐为 5/6。不要在外部代码中假定所有 raw event id 跨核稳定，STA 事件转发需实板确认。

**以太网 TX/RX 与 lwIP**

- 单核 `bk_idk` RX 根据 VIF 找对应 netif；AP RX 还处理 intra-BSS 转发，[wlanif.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/wlanif.c:201)。
- SMP AP CPU 有独立 `g_mlan` 和 `g_uap`，[net.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c:199)。TX 根据 netif 选择 wire id：STA=0、SoftAP=1；RX 用同一 id 送入对应 netif，[wlanif.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/wlanif.c:219)。
- CP 反向映射明确规定 wire 0=infra STA、1=SoftAP、2=P2P GO、3=P2P GC，[cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:46)。
- AP netif 与 lwIP 强耦合：`uap_ip_start()` 配地址并启动 AP IP；`uap_ip_down()`置 netif down 并停止 DHCP server，[net.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c:950)。桥接模式则把 STA/AP netif 都加入 `br0`，[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:2494)。
- 因而对 AP+STA，不能只暴露一个无接口元数据的 Ethernet TX/RX 回调；必须保留 netif/wire-id，或者分别注册 STA/AP netdev。

**contest 现状**

- NuttX wire ABI 只定义 connect/disconnect/scan/get-MAC 等 STA 命令，没有 AP start/stop/config/get-MAC，[bk7258_wifi_ipc.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_wifi_ipc.h:16)。
- `wifi_mode()` 仅保存 `IW_MODE_*` 数值，不向 CP 发送切换命令，[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1723)。设置 `IW_MODE_MASTER` 不会启动 AP。
- 只注册一个 lower-half，默认 `IW_MODE_INFRA`，[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1945)。
- TX 将 CPDU 清零后只写 `type_dst=2`，没有选择 SoftAP wire id，[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1497)。RX 复制帧时完全不读取 VIF/interface 字段，[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:995)。
- CP 固件确实保留 `BK_CMD_START_AP=4`、`STOP_AP=6` 和 AP assoc/disassoc events，[cif_main.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:92)，handler 也会调用 SoftAP demo/API，[cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:362)。这是“CP 能力存在”，不是“NuttX 前端已支持”。
- contest 只编译自己的 `bk7258_wifi.c`，[Make.defs](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/Make.defs:20)，未链接 Armino `libbk_wifi.a`。
